# TodoLot: Talking Reminders

> TodoLot is a voice to-do list app for iPhone (iOS 26.5 or later) that turns what you say into real alarms. Made for forgetful brains and people with ADHD who swipe quiet reminders away: the alarm says the task itself, so it cannot be dismissed without knowing what it was. You dictate a brain-dump, AI splits it into separate tasks with times, and each task becomes a system alarm that rings and says the task out loud at the right moment, even on silent and in Focus mode. No account; tasks stay on the device.

Pains it solves: swiping your own reminders away; alarms named "Alarm 3" that don't say what they are for; tasks that evaporate before you type them; remembering too late (missed appointments, late fees).

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 26.5+. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6797162832
- Free tier: 3 voice captures a day, system-voice alarms, unlimited manual tasks.
- TodoLot Pro: unlimited voice captures, natural human voices, custom wake-up sound. $12.99/week or $149.99/year (USD, varies by region), 3-day free trial, billed by Apple.
- Dictation: any language supported by iOS speech recognition. Natural voices tuned for English, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Hindi, Arabic.
- Features: repeating tasks, advance reminders ("a day before"), quiet notification-only tasks, someday list, morning briefing, month calendar with drag-and-drop, Siri ("Add task in TodoLot").
- Privacy: only dictation text (not audio) and alarm phrase text leave the device; no ads, no selling of data, no account.
- Support email: vibeprogerai@gmail.com
